title: Welcome to Ethics Class
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mr. Takayanagi, a calm and enigmatic high school ethics teacher, meets students in crisis one by one and uses ethical thinking and philosophy to help them face their problems. The episodic seinen drama takes on serious issues that database tags list as bullying, suicide, sexual assault, drugs and delinquency. It was adapted into an NHK television drama in 2021.
life_message: Thinking carefully about right and wrong, with a trusted adult, can help young people face even the hardest parts of life.
